key_idea: See-through sheets show everything that is on both sheets.
steps: The first sheet has a flat bar across the middle.
The second sheet has a standing bar down the middle.
Lay them together and both bars show. They cross in the middle and make a plus shape.

choice_feedback.B: This shows only the flat bar. The standing bar is missing.
choice_feedback.C: This shows only the standing bar. The flat bar is missing.
choice_feedback.D: These bars are slanted, but the sheets have one flat bar and one standing bar.
choice_feedback.E: This has only one flat bar, and it is at the top, not the middle.
